## READ ONLY - Lokalise read for the EN source audit MCP server

Called only by the MCP server workflow. GET only, no body, no write endpoints.
Attach ONLY the 'Lokalise read-only' credential. Never the read-write token.
Keep pagination=cursor in the keys query or you silently get page 1.
Inputs: mode (projects | languages | keys | glossary), project_id, filter_tags.
